chars.KARIM: a young Moroccan man, short curly black hair, light beard, wearing a bright red hoodie, blue jeans and white sneakers, small black backpack
chars.RAYAN: a young Moroccan man, buzz-cut hair, clean-shaven, wearing a mustard-yellow windbreaker jacket, black track pants, a white bandage wrapped around his right shin
chars.MIGUEL: a friendly Venezuelan young man with wavy brown hair, wearing a green football jersey and khaki shorts
chars.MOTHER: Miguel's Venezuelan mother, middle-aged, hair in a bun, wearing a floral blue dress and an apron

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: KARIM and RAYAN walk out of a crowded colorful street market in a small Venezuelan town, looking around confused and lost, RAYAN limping slightly, palm trees and pastel houses in the background, late afternoon

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: KARIM gestures with his hands trying to ask an old Venezuelan street vendor for directions, the vendor shrugs not understanding, RAYAN holds a phone looking worried, small dusty Venezuelan street

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: KARIM and RAYAN stand in the middle of a quiet dusty street while a few local men lean against a wall in the distance staring at them suspiciously, tense atmosphere, Venezuelan town

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: KARIM and RAYAN wait tired at a tiny roadside bus stop shelter in a hilly Venezuelan area, RAYAN sitting rubbing his bandaged leg, KARIM standing looking down the empty road

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: inside an old crowded colorful Venezuelan bus, KARIM and RAYAN sit squeezed by the window, exhausted, green mountains passing outside

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: in front of a simple house in a poor Venezuelan neighborhood, MOTHER rushes out worried with her hands raised, MIGUEL stands next to her relieved but angry, KARIM and RAYAN arrive looking guilty

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: KARIM and RAYAN walk again in a narrow Venezuelan street at dusk, warm street lights turning on, relaxed and chatting, unaware of anything

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: at night on a narrow Venezuelan street, two black SUVs with tinted windows suddenly stop right next to KARIM and RAYAN, headlights glaring on them, both friends freeze in fear
